description: This file defines an abstract base class 'QueueBalancerBase' for managing stream queue balancing within Orleans. It includes methods for initialization, shutdown, subscribing/unsubscribing to queue distribution events, and listening for cluster membership changes, along with internal logging and error handling.

classes.name: QueueBalancerBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for stream queue balancers, including cluster membership monitoring, event subscription, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the queues assigned to this balancer.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue balancer and starts listening for cluster changes.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the queue balancer, cancelling cluster monitoring.

methods.name: SubscribeToQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to queue distribution change events.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from queue distribution change events.

methods.name: NotifyListeners
methods.description: Notifies all subscribed listeners of a queue distribution change.

methods.name: ListenForClusterChanges
methods.description: Asynchronously listens for cluster membership updates and triggers change handling.
